entity.summary: Solana-native non-custodial decentralized exchange providing on-chain spot and derivatives trading, with current mainnet markets and first-party trading surfaces.
entity.notes: Current first-party product surfaces identify Deriverse as a Solana mainnet exchange and expose an active trading interface. The previously recorded first-party volume endpoint now returns HTTP 400 and is no longer used as status evidence. No exact initial launch date, legal entity, or jurisdiction is asserted.

evidence.title: Deriverse official website
evidence.notes: Current first-party website identifies a fully on-chain, non-custodial Solana exchange, reports settlement on Solana mainnet, and exposes current platform statistics.

evidence.title: Deriverse trading interface
evidence.notes: Current first-party trading interface is the canonical Deriverse trading entry point and supports the active classification without relying on the retired or request-sensitive volume endpoint.
